UK Public Transport Faces Fines for Loud Music

A campaign is being launched in England to address antisocial behavior on public transport, specifically loud music played on buses and trains. Passengers playing loud music on buses could face a £100 fine, while a national campaign for rail passengers titled "share the carriage, not the noise" is also being introduced. Reports indicate that 'bare beaters' could face a £1,000 fine for blasting music on British public transport.
